west.description: West aisle viewpoint facing south along the west side of the central equipment. It provides a different line of sight from the east fixed camera. Worker visibility and posture must be determined from a new image.

door.description: Door-approach corridor viewpoint facing west-northwest toward the north aisle. Worker visibility and posture must be determined from a new image.

entrance.description: Entrance viewpoint facing south into the lab. Worker visibility is not guaranteed.
